_doc: Settings only the data pipeline reads (Python scripts and workflows); the app never imports this file. See src/cities/README.md.

imdGrid.note: Bangalore-region grid point on the Deccan plateau (city centre 12.97 N, 77.59 E)

ingres._note: Bengaluru EXTENDS a series rather than owning it: IN-GRES does not serve 2011-2017 per unit, WRIS does (scripts/fetch-wris-groundwater-bangalore.ts), so IN-GRES editions are upserted into the blocks already there. See build_extended().

_notes.years: 2020-2021 is not published. The five editions 2019-20 to 2023-24 equal the WRIS extract they replace, to the rounding.
_notes.unit_names: Substring -> the block name the WRIS series and polygons already use. IN-GRES spells them BENGALURU EAST / Bangalore City / Bangalore-City across editions.
